claim_boundary: This is a deliberately small, manually verified registry for the first Learning -> Market Evidence execution slice. Expired opportunities are rejected automatically; source facts must be refreshed before extending the registry.

opportunities.title: VoltHacks 2026
opportunities.contribution: Build one small hardware/IoT system where circuit/sensor data is turned into a measurable decision; use probability/statistics for thresholds, anomaly detection, uncertainty, or evaluation rather than adding analysis only as decoration.
opportunities.action: Join VoltHacks on Devpost now, create or join a team, choose a hardware/IoT problem, and lock one contribution you can personally own before building.
opportunities.receipt: Devpost registration/team/project URL, followed by the submitted project and judging/result receipt.

opportunities.title: Invent the Future with Arduino UNO Q and App Lab
opportunities.contribution: Turn one circuit/sensing concept into a reproducible Arduino UNO Q build with working code, schematics, BOM, and measured behavior.
opportunities.action: Only if you already have access to an Arduino UNO Q: register, select one real-world problem, and submit a documented working build before the deadline.
opportunities.receipt: Hackster project/submission URL and judging/result receipt.

opportunities.title: 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge
opportunities.deadline_text: Registration remains open through the end of the Nov 14-15, 2026 hackathon
opportunities.contribution: Use NASA/partner open data or an engineering challenge to produce one inspectable model, tool, experiment, or hardware-informed prototype tied to a published challenge statement.
opportunities.action: Register for Space Apps now and choose a local event or the Universal Event; when challenge summaries open, select one challenge where your current capability can own a measurable contribution.
opportunities.receipt: Space Apps registration/event selection, then team/project submission and judging/result receipt.
